summary: Build the off-by-default settings, pairing, status, backup offer, and missing-collection decision surfaces.

produces: Off-by-default Device Sync settings and status
User-initiated backup offer before first connection

conditions: Unconfigured and disabled states make no network call.
Backup export is offered but never starts automatically.
First-time missing collection creation is distinct from replacement of a previously used collection.
The replacement message says the collection may have expired through inactivity or been removed.
Confirm creates once; cancel performs no POST and keeps the decision available.
Every disclosure and trigger obligation in the normative specification is covered.
